description: Is this domain what it claims to be? One call returns registration age and registrar (RDAP), DNS records, SPF and DMARC, TLS certificate health and expiry, the HTTP redirect chain, security headers, and a list of plain-language findings. Use it to vet a merchant, sender or link before trusting it. Live lookups, no API key. 5 free calls per day across all tools; pass `key` to use a prepaid balance (0.01 USDC per call).
name: check_domain
